messages:
Asha: quick async — short status on kernel/continuous-batching/KV prefetch sprint. hitting one sticky dep with eng-infra (memory allocator tweak) that's blocking a perf regression fix. can infra confirm timing? :hourglass: 
Noah: infra side — we queued the allocator change but held it behind validation, scheduled validation run tomorrow 14:00 PT. if it passes we can flip in canary same afternoon. not today. @Asha you want us to try a narrow patch first?
Asha: yes narrow patch would be ideal. main risk is eviction ordering interacting with continuous batching. if allocator flip + narrow patch both land we should re-run the p99 sweep.
Kai: I can pick up the narrow patch and the CR today. tagging me for review: @Kai. will open PR in ~2h.
Noah: FYI found odd log pattern when running the warmup profile: ```kv_cache: miss_count+=1 seq=3189 eviction_candidate=none``` not sure why candidate is none, digging.
Priya: re: perf numbers — last run (dev cluster) showed 5–7% p50 improvement but p99 got worse by ~120ms when continuous batching on. seems correlated with KV warmup misses. maybe we need a short prefix cache for high-cardinality keys.
Kai: good call. I'll add a small prefix cache prototype in PR, feature-flagged. keeps behavior toggled for canary.
InfraBot: deploybot: allocator-validation job scheduled for 2026-03-19T21:00Z. will post results to #eng-infra.
Tom: add JIRA link pls so we can track handoffs. also who owns rollout steps (canary -> regional -> global)?
Asha: JIRA: https://jira/repo/INF-1832 (will add subtask for canary gating). Owners: infra for allocator flip (@Noah), runtime for narrow patch & prefix cache (@Kai), perf & evals (@Priya). rollout plan: canary (0.5% traffic) -> smoke metrics 30m -> 5% -> regional -> global.
Priya: putting a small eval harness in place to compare token-latency traces. will post perf dashboard link when ready.
Kai: PR opened: https://git/repo/pulls/789 — includes narrow allocator-change-compat shim + prefix cache prototype gated by `feature.continuous_prefix`.
Noah: when PR merges we'll run allocator validation + small canary. ping me on merge and I'll coordinate the flip.
Asha: action items summary: 1) Kai open PR (done). 2) Priya add eval harness/dashboard. 3) Noah run validation and schedule canary. 4) I will add the rollout subtask and monitor. closing the async thread — reply if anything needs reassigning. :thumbsup:
